pm-ryan: postmortem follow-up: short-lived ownership for streaming/chat reliability (timeouts, partial responses, reconnects). need owners, short mitigations, alerts, and CI sim.

Sanjay: i'll own reconnect lib + client backoff. will do exp backoff + jitter, ensure KV resume safe. ticket RED-10201.

Maria: i'll add partial_chunk_detected metric and a Prom alert rule. dashboard heatmap by region. ticket RED-10202.

Ken: i'll consolidate runbook (detect -> retry -> fallback -> escalate) and own canary plan. ticket RED-10203.

pm-ryan: concrete items:
- RED-10201 SANJAY: reconnect lib + unit tests + CI harness (ETA Wed)
- RED-10202 MARIA: metric + alert + dashboard (ETA Thu)
- RED-10203 KEN: runbook + canary checklist (ETA Mon)

Sanjay: quick config: backoff_ms=[200,500,1200,2000], jitter=20%, max_retries=4. will add client log fields: request_id, session_id, last_chunk_index, kv_resume_token.

Maria: alert idea: partial_chunk_detected > 4/min for 2m -> page streaming-bridge channel and auto-create prefilled ticket with ids.

Ken: runbook short steps will include curl repros, rollback commands, and ticket template. I'll push to docs/incident-runbooks.

ops-bot: recurring event created: "Streaming Stability Sprint" Mon/Wed 30m starting 2026-03-30. Invites sent.

pm-ryan: owners update RED tickets with acceptance criteria + test plan today. we reconvene next Tue for rollup. escalate to P0 on sustained spikes.

Sanjay: ack, posting PR and CI job shortly.

Maria: ack, will pair on dashboards if needed.

Ken: ack, will publish runbook link here when ready.

pm-ryan: thanks team. this thread is canonical for the remediation owners until we hit 14 clean days.
